Local library copies from the user-supplied yuki.zip, included without modification.

p5.js 2.3.2
https://p5js.org/
https://github.com/processing/p5.js
See the license and third-party notices embedded in p5.js.

p5.mapper
https://github.com/jdeboi/p5.mapper
The provided dist file uses p5.js 2.x / p5.registerAddon.
These are the same library bytes used by the supplied Yuki sketches.

No library is loaded from a CDN by this combined project.
